description: SessionStart adds one line of context (also after /clear or compaction) so Claude loads the skill for every coding task; agents often skip skills for short requests. PostToolUse runs the skill's check-diff script on each edited file and shows Claude known dangers in that file's added lines not yet committed (exit 2 = findings; it exits 0 quietly on anything unexpected).

hooks.command: echo 'For every coding task (writing, fixing, debugging, refactoring, reviewing or testing code, even a small fix), load the agent-skill-ultimate-coding:agent-skill-ultimate-coding skill first and follow it.'
